events.name: Bash
events.head: Read the welcome copy source and outline of pre.md
events.input: $ wc -l cloud/src/reminder-copy.ts workshop-plan/sequences/pre.md && sed -n 1,120p cloud/src/reminder-copy.ts && grep -n "^#" workshop-plan/sequences/pre.md | head -60

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read pre.md placeholders and both confirmation messages
events.input: $ sed -n 1,78p workshop-plan/sequences/pre.md; sed -n 204,244p workshop-plan/sequences/pre.md; git log --oneline -5 -- workshop-plan/sequences/pre.md cloud/src/reminder-copy.ts

events.name: Bash
events.head: Find consumers of pre.md and the state of T-050 and T-052
events.input: $ grep -rln "sequences/pre.md\|pre\.md" --include=*.ts --include=*.mjs --include=*.py --include=*.md --include=*.js --include=*.json . 2>/dev/null | grep -v node_modules | grep -v "tasks/activity\|tasks.json\|\.next" | head -20; grep -n "confirmation\|Confirmation\|placeholder\|first_name\|centre_link\|calendar_link" workshop-plan/sequences/campaign-setup.md | head -20; python3 - <<'E'

events.name: Bash
events.head: Inspect the pre.md builder, sign-off rule and reminder field sources
events.input: $ F=$(git ls-files | grep build_nurture.py); echo $F; wc -l $F; grep -n "first_name\|centre_link\|calendar_link\|zoom_link\|cohort_\|day1_label\|session_time\|Confirmation\|## \|custom\." $F | head -50; grep -n -i "adithya\|sign.off\|signed\|\bAdi\b" workshop-plan/COPY_RULES.md | head; git ls-files | grep -i "nurture" | head; grep -n "cohort_dates\|day1_when\|session_time\|join_page_url" cloud/src/reminders.ts | head -12
